# References this tree quotes as they read on a day, rather than as claims about
# this commit. One entry per line: the document, a tab, and the reference exactly
# as the document carries it.
#
# An entry is a debt and not a dispensation. `.github/lint/pasted-line-reference.sh`
# refuses an entry whose reference has started agreeing with the tree again, and
# refuses an entry no document carries, so neither direction lets one outlive the
# repair it stands in for.
#
# This register is empty and that is the state to keep it in. It held ten entries,
# all of them quotations in `docs/catalogue-checklist.md`, which is a record of two
# catalogue passes and quotes what the files carried on those days. #119 retired
# them by naming the revision each pass was made at, in the
# `<rev>:<path>:<line>:<content>` form the check reads, so those quotations are
# resolved at their own date and judged rather than excused.
#
# Reach for that repair before reaching for an entry here. An entry is for a
# quotation that cannot name a revision; a quotation that can name one is judged,
# and an entry standing in for it is a reference nothing reads.
